title: Maintenance of Annual Average Export Obligation
text: 5.18 Maintenance of Annual Average Export Obligation The excess exports done towards the average export obligation fulfilment of an EPCG authorisation during a year can be used to offset any shortfall in the Average EO done in other year(s) of the EO period or the block period as the case may be provided Average EO imposed is maintained on an overall basis, within the block period or the EO period as applicable.
intent: Support Maintenance of Annual Average Export Obligation processing and compliance validation.
